title: Summit designation, route generation, vista selection
summary: Generate the goals: designate the highest reachable point as the summit, generate two or three routes of rising difficulty structured introduce→develop→twist→resolve, and pick three vistas for view.

acceptance_tests.test: For a corpus environment the service designates a reachable summit, generates 2–3 routes with a per-segment beat, and selects 3 vistas, all written to environment_spec.json.
Beat 1 of every route uses only walk, jog, run, jump, step-up, hop-over, and mantle (Bible §10); three generation retries then a template fallback.
On 10 corpus rooms, a reachable summit and at least two valid routes are produced with no manual fixes on 8 or more.
